# Waymark 0.4.0

A desktop interface remaster inspired by AION 2: restrained slate panels, warm ivory titles, antique gold selection and clean progress displays.

- One compact navigation header replaces the sidebar and repeated page labels.
- Terrain fills the map workspace. Layers and searchable Locations share a floating panel; switching panels is remembered.
- Follow and custom pins stay close at hand. Marker grouping and terrain mode move into Display. Location details and circuits open without resizing the terrain.
- Equal, compact pet cards show portraits, current rank, farming area and tier progress. A focused details dialog and on-demand farming routes keep the card grid tidy.
- Settings uses a clear section list and readable form rows. Saved custom colors still apply, including individual and all-color resets.
- The minimap shares the new game-window styling while retaining saved zoom, position and lock, unlocked wheel zoom, and always-on-top behavior.
- Styled hover and keyboard-focus tooltips provide extra detail without filling the workspace with instructions.

All existing profiles, progress, pins, circuits, filters, follow state, colors and desktop window preferences carry over. Game readers and pet progression logic are unchanged by this visual release.

Validation: 307 regression checks passed (103 frontend, 198 worker, 6 native recovery), with one optional native fixture ignored. Interface checks use an isolated synthetic profile; no game testing or personal data is required for the remaster.
